name: Backpack
description: A backpack is a two-strap bag worn on the shoulders, designed for balanced weight distribution and roomy storage—perfect for daily use, travel, or carrying heavier items comfortably.

name: Cross Body
description: A crossbody bag is a compact, hands-free bag worn across the body with a long strap, offering comfort, security, and easy access to essentials.

name: Handbag
description: A handbag is a stylish carryall designed to be held by hand or worn on the arm, offering both fashion and functionality for everyday essentials.

name: Laptop Bag
description: A laptop bag is a padded, protective bag designed to safely carry a laptop and accessories, featuring organized compartments for tech gear and everyday essentials.

name: Purse
description: A purse is a small, portable bag used to carry essential items like money, cards, and small personal belongings—compact, convenient, and easy to carry daily.

name: Student Bag
description: A student bag is a practical, durable bag designed to carry books, notebooks, and school supplies, often featuring multiple compartments for easy organization and daily use.

name: Travel Bag
description: A travel bag is a spacious, durable bag designed to hold clothing and essentials for trips, offering organized storage and easy portability for short or long journeys.
